Privacy & preview terms

About this website

Stillwell is an illustrative website concept. The brand, services, and articles are sample content. No appointments, payments, or clinical services are offered through this preview.

What is stored

The blog portal saves article changes and uploaded images in this browser’s local storage. Its demo session and theme preference also use browser storage. This is not a secure production account or a shared content system.

Contact forms

The enquiry form validates entries locally. It does not send an email or save submitted information. Please do not enter sensitive or personal health information.

Before launch

The client must supply final privacy terms, business details, approved service content, and editorial review. Secure authentication, shared content storage, and a contact delivery service must be configured before this becomes a live service.
